purpose: low-context cost-aware routing for agents, parallel work and local models

cost_classes.local: no per-call hosted API fee; local compute and licensing still matter
cost_classes.included: uses a plan or credit bucket; verify current allowance
cost_classes.unknown: do not assume cost until verified

prefer: host-native PR/check-suite subscription that resumes the same session
event_driven_ci_continuation.rule: never add timer/polling fallback while a live completion subscription exists; persist state before yielding

delegation_trigger.must_consider_when: task has at least 3 independent bounded workstreams and at least 2 can execute without shared mutable state
delegation_trigger.must_delegate_when: after decomposition, at least 2 read-only/bounded workstreams remain independent and a qualified worker route is already available without disproportionate setup or trust risk
allowed_skip_reasons: no qualified worker route is available
worker setup/coordination cost is credibly greater than the bounded task
workstreams share mutable state that cannot be isolated
delegation_trigger.insufficient_skip_reason: shared project context alone is not sufficient; first carve out bounded read-only workstreams
delegation_trigger.decision_rule: prefer none/local workers; use included host-native workers only when they materially improve wall-clock/context cost

trace_rule.minimum_records: one record per routing/delegation decision that materially changes execution
trace_rule.sink: project audit/final report; use an existing durable audit/log surface when one exists
trace_rule.completion_rule: a whole-project qualification report is incomplete until required trace records are emitted
